commit.message:
fix(ci): exclude the hardware-reports index from Codacy markdownlint

Codacy's markdownlint reads only the root .markdownlint.json, so the
generated docs/hardware-reports/index.md, which the markdownlint-cli2
hook lints under its own directory configuration, would raise Codacy
findings for rules that directory turns off (MD013, MD033).

Add docs/hardware-reports/.markdownlint-cli2.yaml byte-identical to the
nested configuration from pull request #3443 by luoye-cpu, list
docs/hardware-reports/index.md by exact path in the markdownlint
exclude_paths of .codacy.yml, and make test_codacy_config.py fail in
both directions: a nested configuration without the exact Codacy entry
(missing) and an exact entry without its nested configuration (stale).

Signed-off-by: lusoris <lusoris@proton.me>
